b_16_00.scope: Identical frozen source/r/SDSS detections and unchanged C0/W0. A r; B adds all other-band measurements on nights without NSC r; C adds other bands on original r nights. B1 uses the first physical exposure on each new night, not a result-selected exposure. Seasons use the C union and 90day gaps. Time information/leverage is conditional diagonal W0 information, not proof of independent nightly errors. Full reference 4x4 covariance retained. Formal-error pass counts describe this fixed QSO sample, not catalogue yield.
